ui.hero.title: A single platform for every animal in your care
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily operations and teamwork across all your sites. Find any task in Antz, with the real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Tap any card to open its guide, with all the functions and their screens.
ui.cta.text: Each module has its functions and real screens in this guide. Pick up where you left off, or write to us and we will help you.
ui.day.title: What your first day in Antz is like
ui.day.2: Get your bearings on the platform
ui.day.4: Give each person the right access
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles that fit your organization and activate permissions module by module, so that each person sees what their job requires.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app covers field work, such as notes, treatments, transfers and egg records. The web app covers office work, such as the hospital system, the nursery setup, reports and the pharmacy inventory. Updates appear in real time on the phone, the tablet and the computer.
ui.faq.q3: Can we control who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is based on roles. You create the roles your organization uses, for example Zoologist, and activate permissions module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We manage more than one site. Does it work in that case?
ui.faq.a4: Antz gathers the data from all sites and departments in one place. Housing is organized by site, section and enclosure, and transfers between sites go through an approval and a security exit [?].
ui.faq.a5: Start with the Getting Started guide and then open the modules your role uses. If something is unclear, write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Necropsy
m.necropsy.intro: The Necropsy Module documents post-mortem examinations with detailed observations, findings by organ and medical conclusions. It supports an accurate analysis of the cause of death, standardizes reports, ensures timely handling of the carcass and complies with legal, audit and veterinary regulations.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filters
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by site, date and priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Monitor the stages: Incoming, Pending, Draft and Completed.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request information
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, cause, requester and priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The Deworming Module allows antiparasitic treatments to be recorded and monitored systematically, ensuring timely administration, proper documentation and clear follow-up of every deworming of every animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Views by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Dewormings organized into Upcoming, Pending, Skipped and Completed to make follow-up easier.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a treatment or directly record the medicine administered, with defined dates and details.
m.deworming.f3.title: Administration record
m.deworming.f3.desc: Collects the dosage, the batch number, the route of administration, notes and an optional follow-up.
m.housing.title: Housing
m.housing.intro: The Housing module organizes the animals' habitats across your sites, sections and enclosures, so that every animal has a known location and every change is recorded. Access to each level depends on permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Site administration
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit sites with role-based permissions for secure and structured access.
m.housing.f2.title: Section administration
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit sections within the zoo, with permission-based controls for secure administration.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure administration
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit enclosures and monitor each one for efficient control of the animals and the data.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal death
m.fetal-death.intro: The Fetal Death Module records and manages cases of fetal death in the enclosures, collecting the cause, the time and the related animal data. It supports veterinary care, reproductive health monitoring, trend analysis and better population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Add fetal death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new cases: cause, time, kinship and animal data.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filters
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by site, date, stillbirth or abortion, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: View records of the deceased
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full detail: days since death, cause, ID, enclosure, site and sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The Egg Module follows the complete life cycle of eggs, from laying to hatching or transfer to the nursery, ensuring accurate records, real-time updates and complete traceability for better coordination and accountability among the nest, nursery and hatchery teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg panel
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Live counts: in nests, transferred to the nursery, marked for discard.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg record (nest / nursery)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parents, status, dates, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the complete timeline of the egg's journey.
m.administer-medicine.title: Administer medication
m.administer-medicine.intro: The Administration Module complements the Medical History by turning prescriptions into concrete treatment flows, which allows care to be administered in real time to individual animals or in batches, in the field or in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration record for the chosen date without drafting a full medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filters
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Find records quickly and narrow the list by date, entity, species or controlled substance.
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatments by date in four tabs: Pending, Administered, Skipped, Suspended.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The Vaccination Module manages the complete vaccination cycle of animals, from scheduling and direct administration to tracking upcoming, pending, skipped and completed vaccines. It ensures timely treatment, accurate recording of dosage and complete traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Views by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccines organized into Upcoming, Pending, Skipped and Completed to make follow-up easier.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule a vaccination or directly record an administered vaccine, with defined dates and medicine data.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Administration record
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Collects the dosage, the batch number, the route of administration, notes and an optional follow-up.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: It allows medical products to be dispensed quickly, accurately and traceably directly to authorized veterinarians, ensuring timely delivery and automatic updating of the inventory from the prescription to the shelf, with visibility by batch and control of expiry dates at all times.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time information on inventory incidents, shipments, purchases, requests, consumption, expiry dates and high-turnover products, with visual trends to act quickly.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filters
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Find records quickly by request ID, veterinarian name or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Master data (racks and shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organize storage by number of racks and shelves for quick access and updating, with customizable data (packaging, units of measure, active ingredients, controllers [?], manufacturers).
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Inventory report management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Inventory by batch with value and expiry; flag items with low stock or expired; monitor upcoming expiry dates; manage the escrow deposit with dispute resolution.
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product and inventory management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, control inventory and expiry dates, record purchases and shipments, keep a unified logbook and manage substitutes and variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Dispensing management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Veterinarians can prescribe and dispense, or pick up medicines directly at the pharmacy, all of it recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Shipment management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing medicine shipments and complete them in the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Inventory adjustment and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record changes in inventory (missing, broken, expired); keep the audit history; manage returns to suppliers; download reports of consumption, returns, purchases and dispensings for finance and demand forecasting.
m.getting-started.title: Getting started
m.getting-started.intro: The Getting Started guide presents the purpose of the app and accompanies new users through the essential steps to set up their profile, explore the key functions and move around the platform effectively.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and workspaces
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and access your assigned work environment.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home feed to see news, the navigation shortcuts and the bottom panel for the main tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Necropsy / Administration / Assignment pending
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals pending necropsy, administrative documentation and the subsequent assignment or disposal procedures before the final closure of their records.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Master configuration and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Set up the master data and explore modules such as Medical History, Housing, Eggs, Diet and Animal Management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalization
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage your notes, update your profile and adjust your language preferences.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Learn the access levels needed to operate safely.
